name: compta-perso-registry
description: Countries, currencies and financial operators of Africa, with SVG flags, currency signs and logos, for Compta Perso

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .cache/venv && .cache/venv/bin/pip install -q fonttools==4.67.0 && cargo install vtracer@0.6.5 --locked --root .cache/vtracer
scripts.build: node scripts/build-countries.mjs && node scripts/build-signs.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs
scripts.logos:find: node scripts/logos/find.mjs && node scripts/logos/play.mjs && node scripts/logos/commons.mjs
